brief:
Violence linked to Jewish settlers has surged across occupied Palestinian territories as agricultural and religious seasons converge, Al Jazeera English reported. Attacks have struck multiple areas—from olive groves where Palestinians harvest crops to the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in occupied East Jerusalem—marking an uptick in disruptions tied to overlapping seasonal cycles both agricultural and religious in nature.

The escalation reflects broader patterns of tension that intensify during politically and religiously significant periods throughout the year, with settlers using these moments to heighten confrontations against Palestinian communities and their access to land and holy sites.
dek: A new season approaches - religiously, politically and agriculturally - and with it comes corresponding escalation.
title: Settlers intensify attacks on Palestinians as seasonal tensions escalate
